name: The Hollow Pilgrim
bio: No face, no footsteps. It drifts across the field in silk robes and nobody hears it coming.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-14 ("장팔사모", as Meshy names the download: a robed figure; the spear its name speaks of is not in the model; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Its face is blank as downloaded (no face painted in its texture): kept that way (owner, 2026-11-14) unless the owner says otherwise. `locomotion: roll` (owner, 2026-11-14: it moves like the Baseball Robot): what the legs held (the robe's skirt) rides the pelvis, and the game glides it with no walk cycle, leaning into its motion (CharacterAnimator). `surface: rebake`: its download's texture seams held the cut at 18,375 triangles. Placeholder name (the owner renames it on the Roster Board). Core: the owner approved it on 2026-11-14 ("mark all twelve as finished"). Licence: Meshy Community, CC0 per the owner (owner, 2026-11-14: all of this Drive batch are Meshy Community CC0). 2026-11-14: the shooting hand moved onto the grip (gripLong); the support hand stays about 11 cm short of the rifle handguard (its arms are short for `hold.forward` at its -0.15 limit) and its sleeves stretch: grip audit 11 to 9. 2026-11-16: the cause was the download's rig: Meshy put its shoulder joints out at the robe's dropped shoulder seam (upper arm 9.7 cm, the arm chain a sixth of its height against a fifth to a third on other looks), so the support hand could not reach; `rejoint.upperarm 0.7` moves each shoulder 5.3-5.5 cm in along the collarbone with the skin past it, `supportLong` ahead 15 cm (the slide back is judged before the -0.15 hold pulls the gun in), `supportPistol` round the shooting hand, finger `lanes 0.8` (an index tip that tore 11x off its neighbours): grip audit 9 to 3 (rifle support hand 12 to 6 cm, shotgun 25 to 18, pistol 5 to 2). Its wide hanging sleeves ride the forearms whole (cloth, not stretched skin).
